description: Bounded source-shaped median-cut construction of an RGB palette from a small pixel set.

pinned_source.license_note: No explicit license grant was found in the pinned tiffmedian.c file. The package is a clean-room implementation of the abstract algorithm and includes no upstream source text or comments. The separate bundled tiffio.h notice is not treated as a license for tiffmedian.c.

contract.operation: Construct the source-shaped median-cut RGB palette from the occupied 5-bit-per-channel histogram bins. The bounded package stops before TIFF output rendering and pixel-index mapping.
contract.histogram: RGB components are quantized by shifting right three bits, producing a 32x32x32 histogram.
contract.box_selection: Select the first source-order box with greatest population among boxes with a nonzero channel range.
contract.split_axis: Longest channel span; ties prefer red, then green, then blue.
contract.split_rule: Accumulate per-axis histogram counts to floor(box_population/2), advancing one bin when the median position is the first bin. The lower box is inserted at the front of the palette list.
contract.shrink_rule: Contract both child boxes to the minimum and maximum occupied histogram coordinates on each channel.
contract.palette_rule: Emit 4*(minimum_bin+maximum_bin) for each channel, in current source box-list order.
contract.errors: Malformed framing, invalid palette or pixel counts, and non-byte RGB components return -1. Null output or insufficient capacity returns -2 without writes.

output.encoding: palette count followed by RGB palette entries

workspace.meaning: Maximum caller-provided palette output buffer for eight RGB entries and their count.
